June’s Painting
June painted a sun for her mom. Then she bumped her cup. Blue water spilled on the picture. June dabbed it with a paper towel. The blue spot stayed. So she painted the spot into a bird. Now a bird flew next to the sun. Her mom loved it.

visual.text:
Raj’s Missing Shoe
Raj had to leave for school. He could find only one shoe. He looked by the door. It was not there. Then he heard his puppy chewing. He followed the sound to the couch. The puppy had his shoe! Raj gave the puppy a toy for the shoe. He made it to the bus on time.
